name: Cars Physics Drive 2
desc:
Get ready to rev, race, and crash  in Cars Physics Drive 2! Choose your vehicles, defy physics, and dive into the craziest driving adventure on Roblox. It's fast, it's fun, and it's all about epic crashes and glitches. You can also jump out of a vehicle high in the sky and ragdoll

Don't forget to like the game 👍

UPDATE LOGS
- LAG REDUCED ALOT

🎮 Controls
WASD: Driving
E/Q/ButtonY/ButtonX: Shift up and down
M/DPadUp: Change from automatic to manual
V/ButtonL3 : First person camera
H: Horn
L: Lights
R: Mouse controls (only works for some vehicles)
P: Parking Brake
LeftCtrl/PullThumbstick1Down: Wheelie, motorcycle only
Shift/ButtonB: Nitro, some vehicles only

Version 2.5
